notes:
**Update: keep the map on while showing items, and more installs can read the map**

Short version: a new switch keeps your map on screen while you hold Alt to show items, and the map now works on game installs that used to say "Gamefiles could not be read".

## New

- **Keep map with items.** Find it in the map settings, right next to **Always shown**. Off by default, so nothing changes until you turn it on. When it is on, holding Alt (show items) no longer closes the map, and item tooltips still show. The open/close map hotkey still closes the map whenever you want.

## Fixed

- **"Gamefiles could not be read" on some installs.** A few Diablo II: Resurrected installs store a game file a little differently, and the map could not open them. It now reads those installs too. If you saw that message, update and try again.

## Good to know

- If the message still shows after updating, in Battle.net open Diablo II: Resurrected, click the gear icon and choose Scan and Repair, then start the app again.

Tickets and feedback are always welcome. Use **REQUEST FEATURE** in the top bar.
